Title: Re: " Cannot use equipment " and Summon Spirit Beast

Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Heys!

Yet again i stand in need of your guidance!

Question #1

Howler cannot use any weapons. Does it forbid her but to have one? What if that equipment is  Talbot's Chainsaw ? I suppose she can't enter combat or use its preventation but the Chainsaw's damage dealing ability still works?

According to that, a minion with  Wildebeest can possess  Heart of Nizchetus but is forbidden to draw cards during untap because it is considered "using" the equipment?

Question #2

Can  Summon Spirit Beast be played in any section of blocking and combat? For example the opposing minion plays  Taste of Vitae ... that means he cannot press any further so I play Summon at X blood knowing the combat surely ends. Can i "neutralize" an opposing minion's S:CE by Summoning a  Dog Pack immediately after he played his strike? If I Summon an  Elephant Guardian in combat, will Dumbo remember who's acting?

About remembering... as far as I know a  Sniper Rifle cannot be used right away if equipped via  Concealed Weapon ... Can  Carlton be burned if the diablerie had occured before Carlton was played?

Sry for flooding

NC of Hungary

///

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Malachy wrote:
> Heys!
>
> Yet again i stand in need of your guidance!
>
> Question #1
>
> Howler cannot use any weapons. Does it forbid her but to have one?
>
No. She can have equipments and perform equip actions.
>
> Malachy wrote:
> What if that equipment is  Talbot's Chainsaw ? I suppose she can't enter combat or use its preventation but the Chainsaw's damage dealing ability still works?
>
If the Talbot's Chainsaw is on Howler, then
- Howler can't use it to enter combat
- Howler can't use it to strike
- Howler can't use it to prevent damage
- Howler doesn't get a press from the Chainsaw
- Howler can hunt

I think the latest ruling I saw from LSJ regarding the untap phase damage (2006, aI think) said it didn't happen if the bearer couldn't use weapons. However, the latest I can find (2004) asys it does inflict damage. Let me put that one on hold for the moment.

> Malachy wrote:
> According to that, a minion with  Wildebeest can possess  Heart of Nizchetus but is forbidden to draw cards during untap because it is considered to "use" the equipment?
>
Same as above.

> Malachy wrote:
> Question #2
>
> Can  Summon Spirit Beast be played in any section of blocking and combat? For example the opposing minion plays  Tase of Vitae ... that means he cannot press any further so I play Summon at X blood knowing the combat surely ends. Can i "neutralize" an opposing minion's S:CE by Summoning a  Dog Pack immediately after he played his strike?
>
No. Guard Dogs aren't retroactive. If the strike were Form of Mist, the action would still continue. EDIT VR20190412: This ruling is no longer valid, see answer below.
>
> Malachy wrote:
> If I Summon an  Elephant Guardian in combat, will Dumbo remember who's acting?
>
There is always a minion considered acting. This is required by sequencing rules.

> Malachy wrote:
> About remembering... as far as I know a  Sniper Rifle cannot be used right away if equipped via  Concealed Weapon ...
>
Cannot be used to set the ranged when equipped via Concealed Weapon in the blocking combat, right.  [LSJ 20021028]
>
> Malachy wrote:
> Can  Carlton be burned if the diablerie had occured before Carlton was played?
>
Yes.
The difference between these two is that Sniper Rifle reads "if the bearer blocks an action", which is the requirement to be able to set the range.

Apparently, the ruling was given by mail, so it wasa never made official (please, if someone can prove me wrong, I'll be happy  ).
So, back to the most recent ruling by LSJ:  [LSJ 20040608] : If Howler has a Talbot's Chainsaw during your untap phase, Talbot's Chainsaw inflicts 3 damage to one of your ready minions.

> Pascal wrote:
>
> > Malachy wrote:
> > According to that, a minion with  Wildebeest can possess  Heart of Nizchetus but is forbidden to draw cards during untap because it is considered to "use" the equipment?
> >

>
"Same as above" now changed meaning. A vampire with a Wildebeeste would draw cards from their Heart of Nizchetus during untap phase, if they're ready.
